en: Color photo postcard showing the central square of Oradea, Romania: a wide square with an orange tram, the yellow Biserica cu Lună (Moon Church) with its dark spire, the Oradea City Hall clock tower in the distance, and ornate historic palaces around the square. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 BANI POSTA ROMANA stamp, and a București cancellation dated 19.4.71. Publisher credit and price are printed.
